title: AHA hooks file
description: A hooks file: Claude Code's `hooks` object, event name to groups.

hooks.description: Claude Code's event names (`PreToolUse`, …) to their groups.

Group.description: A group: a matcher on Claude Code's tool name, and its entries.

matcher.description:
A regular expression matching the whole tool name; absent, empty or
`*` matches every call.

type.description:
`command`: a shell command line. Claude Code's other types (e.g.
`prompt`) are kept but not run.

timeout.description: Seconds before the command is stopped (60 when absent).

tool.description:
The tool that wrote the entry; such entries are installed by that
tool into every harness itself, so dispatch skips them.
